negativeTargets: Synthetic Gaussian/impulsive noise only. Recorded 20 m day/night backgrounds are additive interference for speech. The 40 m day recording was excluded from this adaptation but may have been used by the upstream pretrained model.
selection: Selected on continuous development, SAQ development and supplementary development recordings before final holdouts were opened. Runtime uses causal AGC and resampling; accuracy differs from the global peak normalization used during training.
trainingCorrections: Complete utterances replace partial dense crops; distinct utterances separated by a full second.
Nonempty CTC targets include boundary spaces, matching pretrained vocabulary training.
Empty-target CTC loss normalized by output frame count rather than target-length clamp of one.
